exposure: one-day outpatient management model for GDM
outcome: weight gain at the end of pregnancy
cohort: Patients admitted to obstetrics clinics and diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM).
finding: The one-day outpatient management model was more beneficial for controlling blood glucose levels and weight gain during pregnancy, and significantly decreased the incidence of macrosomia and neonatal hypoglycemia in GDM patients.
